denominator.pin_coordinates_from: jobs/all-pins-nc-audit.results.json (228 components, 782 pins, coherent with the frozen component placement for 227 of 228)

method: Union-find over the frozen sheet's own WIRE geometry (segment vertices, plus T-junctions where a vertex lies on the interior of another segment; pure crossings deliberately NOT joined), with pin primitives unioned at their readback coordinates. A second layer merges geometric clusters that carry the same NET label, because EasyEDA net labels join by name. Net names were never used to decide whether a pin is attached. The oracle carries a 7-case fault battery including two cases that must go red.
disposition_convention: 'disposition' is the AUDIT VERDICT - the state the pin must end in. 'as_captured' is what the frozen sheet actually shows. Where they differ, the pin is a defect and 'defect' is true.

pins.name: ILM
pins.basis: ILM, R1 1.33k. TI SLVSFC9C Eq.5: R_ILM = 3334/I_ILM gives I_LIM = 2.507 A typ, 2.26-2.76 A over the +/-10 % band. DEVICE-BINDING DEFECT: R1-PWR1 is bound to EasyEDA device e1b1f220e40a4edea589adfa05a5d8c7, a 10 kohm device shared with 23 other parts (15 drawn '10k'). A BOM emitting 10 kohm gives I_LIM 0.333 A typ / 0.300 A guaranteed and the board cannot power up. SPECIFIED VALUE: 1.24 kohm +/-1 % 0402 (2.689 A typ, 2.420 A min, 2.958 A max) per power-envelope-rederivation.md section 6. Instance supplier code C276261 is correct for the drawn 1.33 kohm but the drawn value itself is superseded.

pins.name: VDD_USB_CAP
pins.basis: VDD_USB_CAP, currently C74 100 nF + C75 10 uF. NXP publishes NO capacitance value for VDD_USB_CAP in IMXRT1060CEC Rev.4 Table 82 or HDG Rev.3 Table 2 (contrast VDD_HIGH_CAP, which is specified). Value is unresolved against vendor documentation.

pins.name: USB_OTG1_DP
pins.basis: USB_OTG1_DP. NXP IMXRT1060CEC Rev.4 Table 87 (12x12 mm ball map). Dedicated analog USB PHY pin: Table 86 shows no Power Group / Ball Type / Default Mode / GPIO alternate. D-044 requires J1 D+ to terminate here.

pins.name: USB_OTG1_DN
pins.basis: USB_OTG1_DN. NXP IMXRT1060CEC Rev.4 Table 87. Dedicated analog USB PHY pin, no IOMUX alternate. D-044 requires J1 D- to terminate here.
pins.wrong_connection: USB_OTG1_DN is wired to OPT_USB_AUD_RT -> R56-VAL (10k, marked DNP) -> OPT_USB_AUD -> J11-VAL.2. NXP IMXRT1060CEC Rev.4 Table 86 gives ball M8 no Power Group, no Ball Type, no Default Mode and no GPIO alternate: it is a dedicated analog USB PHY pin and cannot serve as an option strap. WRONG CONNECTION.

pins.name: USB_OTG1_CHD_B
pins.basis: USB_OTG1_CHD_B. NXP IMXRT1060CEC Rev.4 Table 5 (recommended connections for unused analog interfaces) and HDG s7.5: leave not connected. Requires an explicit No-Connect flag.

pins.name: USB_OTG1_VBUS
pins.basis: USB_OTG1_VBUS. NXP IMXRT1060CEC Rev.4: recommended 4.40-5.50 V, absolute max 5.50 V, not part of the power-up sequence (s4.2.1.1). NXP HDG MIMXRT105060HDUG Rev.3 Table 2 requires 1 x 1 uF / 10 V to GND and specifies NO divider.

u9_esp_note: U9-ESP (ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8) is out of the named scope but is the counterparty of J7's data and VBUS-sense nets. Measured: 0 of its 41 pins touch any wire in the frozen state.

bom_binding_defect.failure_mode: R_ILM = 3334/I_LIM, so 10 kohm gives 0.333 A typ / 0.300 A guaranteed on BOTH eFuses; the trunk cannot start the 3V3 buck (0.480 A peak) and the board is dead at bring-up
bom_binding_defect.buck_feedback_divider: R5-PWR2 on the all-100k device (8/8 members), R6-PWR2 on a device unique to it. CLEAN - positively verified, not inferred from absence.
